correctness.rationale: The exact semidirect commutator identity and uniform-on-image lemma are proved. For first Engel words the only deterministic-zero exponent pair is (0,0); for higher words the zero exponent is b=0, and all nonzero b give a surjective N^k coefficient. The inverse formulas recover all ranks, and Jordan second differences plus r_0=d and r_p=0 recover all block sizes. The sharp pair has identical lower ranks and different group nilpotency classes. Direct exhaustive checks and an independent finite inversion checker both return VERIFY_OK; neither is substituted for proof.

value.rationale: A natural targeted sequence of Engel-word probabilities exactly determines the modular C_p-action within an infinite family of finite p-groups. The pointwise distribution gives further word-measure data. A sharp family of equal-order nonisomorphic examples shows the shortest universal recognition horizon is p-1, which is an intrinsically motivated finite invariant and not a random parameter census.
